chunks.subject: Database Systems
chunks.text:
Database Normalization
Normalization is the process of organizing data to reduce redundancy and improve integrity.
In a well-designed database, each fact should appear in one place. This makes updates easier and re
1NF: Each table cell contains a single value and each row is unique.
2NF: A table is in 2NF when it is already in 1NF and all non-key attributes depend on the full primary k
3NF: A table is in 3NF when it is in 2NF and all non-key attributes depend only on the primary key, not
Example: A StudentCourse table may store student_id, student_name, course_id, course_name, and 
This design repeats student and course details. By separating the data into Student, Course, and Enro
A student who enrolls in two courses should not have to repeat the same student information in multip
Normalization improves consistency, reduces update anomalies, and keeps relational data easier to q

questions.question: Which normal form removes partial dependency in a relation?
questions.explanation: 2NF removes partial dependency by ensuring all non-key attributes depend on the complete primary key.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of normalization?
questions.explanation: Normalization organizes data to reduce duplication and improve integrity.

questions.question: True or false: 3NF allows transitive dependencies between non-key attributes.
questions.explanation: 3NF prevents transitive dependencies, so non-key attributes should not depend on other non-key attributes.
